newsitem.title: USA: More bids submitted for United Healthcare -- paper.
newsitem.headline: More bids submitted for United Healthcare -- paper.

text.p: Five health care providers have offered plans to rescue New Jersey's troubled United Healthcare System, the Star Ledger reported Tuesday.
Primary Health Systems, a Pennsylvania hospital management company, has submitted a joint bid with Jersey City Medical Center, the paper said, citing sources familiar with the negotiations.
On Monday, the Cathedral Healthcare System and the University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey teamed up to offer a $20 million takeover of United's Children's Hospital.
Sources close to the negotiations said the other bidders were Saint Barnabas Healthcare System, Medical Management of America, and First Medical Corp, the newspaper said.
